name: Pendulum serve: four spins, one motion
purpose: Serve backspin, sidespin, no-spin and topspin with the same-looking pendulum motion.

variants.instructions: Serve 5 of each spin. Your partner calls out the spin they think it is. Count how often they guess wrong.
Basket of balls. 5 of each spin, then mix them. Watch the second bounce: backspin stops or comes back, topspin runs on.
variants.feederInstructions: Collect balls and tell them which spin you saw.

variants.instructions: Robot off, basket of balls. 5 of each spin, then mix.
Fold the table out to full length, then serve from a basket: 5 of each spin, then mix.
No table: practise the toss and the four contacts in the air. Brush under (backspin), around the side (sidespin), behind (no-spin), up the back (topspin).

success.description: 7 of 10 serves with the spin you meant.

coachingPoints: Same toss and swing for every spin
Spin comes from where you brush the ball
Contact low, just above the table

name: Disguise your serve
purpose: Hide the spin: change only the contact, not the look of the motion.

variants.instructions: Serve heavy backspin or no-spin that look the same. Your partner must push every serve; count how many they pop up or put in the net.
Basket of balls. Alternate heavy backspin and no-spin with the same motion; check the ball's behaviour after the second bounce.
variants.feederInstructions: Watch and tell them if you could see the difference.

variants.instructions: Robot off. Alternate heavy backspin and no-spin with the same motion and a big follow-through after contact.

success.description: 5 of 10 serves misread by the receiver.

coachingPoints: Fast arm, gentle contact for no-spin
Hide contact with a follow-through
Same rhythm every time

name: Reverse pendulum serve practice
purpose: Learn the reverse swing for sidespin the other way.

variants.instructions: Serve reverse sidespin short. Your partner pushes it back; watch which way it kicks.
Basket of balls. Reverse pendulum, sidespin-backspin, short.
variants.feederInstructions: Collect and tell them where it bounced.

variants.instructions: Robot off. Basket of balls: reverse pendulum serves, short.
No table: practise the reverse swing and the contact on the left side of the ball (right side for left-handers).

coachingPoints: Elbow up, bat swings from left to right (right to left if left-handed)
Contact on the left side of the ball (right side if left-handed)
Bend the knees to keep it low

name: Tomahawk serve practice
purpose: A sidespin serve with the bat tip up, swinging across the body.

variants.instructions: Tomahawk serves short and long. Your partner returns them; watch the kick.
Basket of balls. Tomahawk serves: short sidespin-backspin, then long sidespin.
variants.feederInstructions: Collect and report the bounce spot.

variants.instructions: Robot off. Basket of balls: tomahawk serves.
No table: practise the tomahawk swing with the bat tip up, brushing across the ball.

coachingPoints: Bat tip up, elbow high
Brush across the side of the ball
Toss a little in front

name: Backhand serve practice
purpose: A compact serve from in front of the body: backspin and sidespin.

variants.instructions: Backhand serves short and long. Your partner pushes or attacks; play 3 balls.
Basket of balls. Backhand serves: backspin short, sidespin long.
variants.feederInstructions: Collect and tell them how short it was.

variants.instructions: Robot off. Basket of balls: backhand serves.
Fold the table out to full length; basket of balls: backhand serves.
No table: practise the toss and the backhand serving swing in front of your body.

coachingPoints: Stand square, ball in front of your body
Elbow leads, wrist snaps at contact
Recover quickly: you are close to the table

name: Short serve precision
purpose: Short serves that would bounce twice: the key to stopping your opponent's attack.

variants.instructions: Your partner lets each serve bounce. Count serves that bounce twice on their side before the end line.
Basket of balls. Short serves only; a target sheet near the net on the far side.
variants.feederInstructions: Watch for the second bounce and call 'two' or 'long'.

variants.instructions: Robot off. Short serves to a target near the net.
Fold the table out to full length; short serves to a target near the net.

coachingPoints: First bounce close to the net on your side
Low contact, gentle touch
Backspin keeps it short

name: Attack the long serve
purpose: Punish long serves: step back a touch, read the spin and attack with topspin.

variants.instructions: Your partner mixes short and long serves. Attack every long one with topspin; push the short ones.
The feeder serves long with mixed spin. Attack each one.
variants.feederInstructions: Serve long from your end: backspin, sidespin, topspin, mixed.

variants.instructions: Robot on long balls with mixed spin to random sides. Attack every ball.

success.description: 6 of 10 long serves attacked onto the table.

coachingPoints: Stand ready to step back for long serves
Read the spin, then pick the bat angle
Spin first on the return

name: Read the spin
purpose: Learn to tell the spin from the server's bat: call it before the ball reaches you.

variants.instructions: Your partner serves with mixed spin. Call 'back', 'side', 'top' or 'none' out loud before the bounce, then return it.
The feeder serves with mixed spin. Call the spin before the bounce, then return.
variants.feederInstructions: Serve mixed spins from your end; tell them if the call was right.

variants.instructions: No table: watch serve clips of good players at slow speed and call the spin from the bat path at contact. 20 serves.

coachingPoints: Watch the bat at contact, not the ball
Up = topspin, under = backspin, around = sidespin
Fast arm with a soft touch often means no-spin

name: Receive anything
purpose: Short or long, any spin: choose push, drop, flick or attack.

variants.instructions: Your partner serves anything. Choose the return and play 3 balls. 10 serves, then swap.
The feeder serves anything from their end. Pick the right return each time.
variants.feederInstructions: Mix short and long, all spins, all placements.

variants.instructions: Robot on random length, spin and placement. Pick the right return each time.

coachingPoints: Decide short or long first
Low and deep by default
Attack anything long

name: Drive or smash
purpose: Normal balls get a drive, high balls get a smash: choose fast.

variants.instructions: Normal topspin with every third ball high. Drive the normal ones, smash the high one.
variants.feederInstructions: Two normal balls, then one high ball. Repeat.

variants.instructions: Your partner drives two balls, then lobs one. Drive, drive, smash.
If your robot can vary height: two normal balls, then a high one. Drive, drive, smash.

success.description: 7 of 10 sequences with both shots on the table.

coachingPoints: Recover after each drive
See the high ball early
Move under it before you swing

name: Lob, then counter
purpose: Lob until a ball comes weaker, then counter-attack and step back in.

variants.instructions: Your partner smashes; after 3 lobs they play a softer ball. Counter-attack it and play on.
Three firm balls deep (lob them), then one slower ball (counter it).
variants.feederInstructions: Three firm flat balls deep, then one slower topspin.

coachingPoints: Lob high and deep
Watch for the softer ball
Counter with spin, then step in
